title: Maker Space Visits Participation Gap Alert
dataSources: Club attendance (`club:attendance`), running-club sessions (`runningclub:session`), maker-space visits (`makerspace:visit`), book-club meetings (`bookclub:meeting`), community events (`community:event`).
app: Book-club attendance, running-club miles, maker-space visits, and general social-club participation logs streamed to Splunk HEC via forms, check-ins, and calendar exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=makerspace:visit
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by member
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| where days_since>21
| sort - days_since
description: Flags members or households that have gone quiet on maker space visits longer than expected.
value: Gaps matter because belonging usually fades gradually; a gentle alert can help restart the habit before it disappears.
implementation: Adjust the gap threshold to the normal cadence of the club or activity.
visualization: Table of member values by days since last participation.
grandmaExplanation: It lists who has drifted away from maker space visits long enough to merit a nudge.
